name: robot-app-harness
description: Closed-loop workflow for writing robot application software against a rig (a robot plus its sensors and actuators) using the `rah` harness in this repository: probe the devices, write drivers and task code, run it in simulation, read the evaluator report, and iterate until it passes held-out seeds. Use this skill when the user asks to make a robot do a task, to integrate a sensor or actuator into a robot application, to write pick-and-place or other manipulation code for a rig, or to "vibe code" robotics software and verify it in a simulator. Trigger on mentions of rah, rig manifests, robot task specs, the ARMATURE simulator, probing robot devices, device descriptors, running or verifying a robot app, held-out seeds, or diagnosing why a simulated robot task fails.

findings.excerpt: export ARMATURE_HOME=/path/to/armature   # checkout with `npm ci` already run, Node.js 22+
rah init my_app --rig <rig.json> --task <task.json>   # creates my_app/app.py and LESSONS.md
rah run --rig <rig.json> --task <task.json> --app my_app/app.py --note "what this attempt changes"
